workflow_id.title: Workflow Id
workflow_id.description: The agent an unsaved draft belongs to. With it, the draft's `"user"` items read the caller's account choices for that agent.

parameters.title: Parameters
parameters.description: An unsaved draft's parameters (`{agent: {...}}`), checked instead of a saved revision.

schema.title: WorkflowRevisionRequirementsQueryRequest
schema.description: One agent configuration to check: a saved revision, or an unsaved draft.
